Why book Dubai tours with Phoenix Travel & Tours?

Phoenix Travel & Tours is a licensed Dubai tour operator headquartered at Office 701, XL Tower, Business Bay, Dubai. We provide verified transparent AED rates, door-to-door hotel transfers, and a pay-on-arrival booking policy with instant WhatsApp confirmation (+971 56 150 5270)—no upfront credit card charge required.

All tours are executed with licensed professional safari marshals and air-conditioned 4x4 vehicles. We operate daily morning and evening desert safaris in the prestigious Lahbab Red Dunes, private quad bike and dune buggy rentals, and customizable UAE city tours.
